dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: Greetings. New data recovery category detected.

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: ...Initial data detected. All data entries have been added.

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: Thank you... for your help. I have... recalled my name via the retrieved data.

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: At the time, my creator, Lord Xiuhcoatl, was exhibiting signs of memory degradation and distortion, and the kinsman he cherished most had already severed ties with him...

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: Perhaps he meant to fill the void left by one who had accompanied him since birth, and thus, on the day I was created...

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: "Then you shall be 'Kukulkan.' I imagine that fellow could hardly care less about that name by now..."

dialogues.speaker: "Kukulkan"
dialogues.text: As such, I am not a nameless Secret Source Servant. Rather, my name is...
